title: 学术独白的信号表达
goal: 识别学术独白中的逻辑信号及后续信息的作用。

points.label: 听出信号表达所属的逻辑类别
判断后续信息在独白中的作用

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 学术独白信号表达与听力课教学规格

body.p: 信号表达说明前后两部分信息的逻辑关系。判断一条信息的作用，先听出信号表达，再联系前后的内容。
For example 后面是前一句所说类别中的一个实例。therefore 后面是根据前文的依据得出的结论。

cards.title: 定义与举例
rows: A habitat is defined as the place where an organism lives.
Migration refers to movement between regions.
In this study, abundance means the number of individuals observed.
Erosion is the term for the wearing away of material.
Some birds migrate; for example, swallows travel seasonally.
Several materials absorb water; for instance, paper absorbs it.
Some insects, such as bees, visit flowers.
Some metals can be recycled; one example is aluminium.

cards.title: 对比与因果
rows: The first sample was dry; however, the second was damp.
The upper layer is coarse; in contrast, the lower layer is fine.
Sand drains quickly, whereas clay retains water longer.
The first method is quick. On the other hand, the second is more detailed.
The soil dried because the temperature rose.
The temperature rose; as a result, the soil dried.
Increased heat leads to faster evaporation.
The change is due to increased heat.

cards.title: 修正与结论
rows: The sample was not clay but rather fine sand.
The change occurred in spring, more precisely in April.
The count was fifteen; I should say fifty.
The distance was about a kilometre, or 900 metres to be precise.
Both samples were dry; therefore, neither contained visible moisture.
In conclusion, the observations support the proposed explanation.
To sum up, the two methods measure different features.
Overall, the results suggest a decline in the count.

lines.text: A habitat refers to the place where an organism lives.

items.stem: What relationship does 'refers to' introduce here?
items.why: refers to 后面解释 habitat 的意思，属于定义，即第一项。

lines.text: Some metals can be recycled. For instance, aluminium can be recycled.

items.stem: What relationship does 'for instance' introduce here?
items.why: for instance 后的 aluminium 是可回收金属的例子。

lines.text: The first sample was dry. However, the second was damp.

items.why: however 连接干燥与潮湿两种不同状态，表示对比。

lines.text: The count was fifteen; I should say fifty.

items.stem: What relationship does 'I should say' introduce here?
items.why: I should say 后的 fifty 修正先前的 fifteen。

lines.text: Some insects visit flowers. For example, bees collect nectar there.

items.stem: What role does the statement about bees play?
options: It defines what a flower-visiting insect is.
It gives an instance of flower-visiting insects.
It corrects the earlier claim about insects.
It draws a conclusion about all flower visitors.
items.why: for example 后面的 bees 是访花昆虫中的一个实例，即第二项。

lines.text: Both samples were dry. Therefore, neither contained visible moisture.

items.stem: What role does the statement after 'therefore' play?
options: It offers an example of a dry sample.
It corrects the description of the samples.
It draws a conclusion from the observation.
It explains why the samples became dry.
items.why: Both samples were dry 是观察，therefore 后面是由此得出的结论，即第三项。

lines.text: In this study, density means the number of plants per unit area.

items.why: means 后说明本研究中 density 的含义。

lines.text: The first soil was coarse. In contrast, the second was fine.

items.stem: What relationship does 'in contrast' introduce here?
items.why: in contrast 前后是两种不同的土壤质地，表示两者的差别，即第二项。

lines.text: The container warmed; as a result, the ice melted.

items.stem: What relationship does 'as a result' introduce here?
items.why: as a result 后面的 the ice melted 是容器升温带来的结果，即第三项。

lines.text: The meeting took place in May, more precisely on the fifth of May.

items.stem: What relationship does 'more precisely' introduce here?
items.why: more precisely 把 in May 说得更准确：on the fifth of May。这属于修正，即第四项。

groups.text: Several materials absorb water. For example, paper absorbs it.

items.stem: What role does the statement about paper play?
options: It concludes the statement about materials.
items.why: for example 后面的 paper 是吸水材料的一个实例，用来说明前一句的概括，即第一项。

groups.text: The two readings were identical. Therefore, their difference was zero.

items.stem: What role does the statement after 'therefore' play?
options: It gives an example of a reading.
It draws a conclusion from the readings.
It replaces one reading with another.
It explains why the two readings were identical.
items.why: The two readings were identical 是依据，therefore 后面得出差值为零的结论，即第二项。

groups.text: The upper layer is coarse, whereas the lower layer is fine.

items.stem: What role does the statement about the lower layer play?
options: It explains the cause of both layers.
It gives an example of an upper layer.
It contrasts with the coarse upper layer.
It revises the description of the upper layer.
items.why: whereas 把下层的 fine 和上层的 coarse 相对比，即第三项。

groups.text: The sample was clay—or rather, it was fine sand.

options: It gives an example of clay.
It states that clay and sand are both present.
It concludes that both descriptions are equivalent.
items.why: or rather 后面的 fine sand 取代了前面的 clay，属于修正，即第四项。
